hero_iskanderkul_desc: A breathtaking alpine lake surrounded by the majestic Fann Mountains — one of Tajikistan's natural jewels.
hero_nurek_desc: Enjoy the turquoise waters of Nurek — one of the world's tallest dams and a true marvel of engineering.
hero_somoni_desc: The symbol of Tajik unity — standing tall in the heart of Dushanbe.
hero_attire_desc: Colorful Tajik dresses that reflect centuries of craftsmanship and cultural pride.
hero_khujand_desc: Ancient hills and vibrant markets, where history and modern Tajik life intertwine.
hero_museum_desc: Discover artifacts and art that tell the story of our rich civilization.
hero_pamir_desc: Known as 'The Roof of the World' — home to stunning peaks and serene valleys.
hero_mosque_desc: An elegant architectural gem — a place of peace and faith in Dushanbe.
hero_tajikistan_desc: Discover the culture, nature, and traditions of Tajikistan. Let your next adventure begin here.
culture_desc: Tajikistan is a land of ancient traditions, vibrant crafts, and warm hospitality. From traditional dances to colorful markets, every corner tells a story.
navruz_desc: Participate in the traditional, joyful process of making Sumanak with local women. Experience songs, dances, and ancient traditions.
navruz_warning: Available only annually from March to April.
ceramics_desc: Work with clay on a pottery wheel to create your own traditional piyala or plate. Learn the secrets of Tajik wood carving.
jewelry_desc: Masterclass on weaving intricate Pamiri necklaces and traditional beadwork. Take home a unique piece of cultural heritage.
dance_desc: Immerse yourself in the rhythm of Tajik culture. Learn the graceful movements of traditional dances from professional performers.
place_pamir_desc: The roof of the world — breathtaking landscapes and ancient routes of the Silk Road.
place_dushanbe_desc: The vibrant capital city known for its culture, architecture, and modern growth.
place_istaravshan_desc: One of the oldest cities in Central Asia, home to artisans and ancient fortresses.
place_isfara_desc: A city famous for its apricots, kind people, and rich cultural traditions.
place_khujand_desc: A historical center of trade and culture along the Syr Darya River.
place_khorog_desc: A peaceful mountain town — the heart of Pamir culture and hospitality.
tours_desc: Explore the most breathtaking routes and destinations across Tajikistan. Your adventure starts here!
tour_dushanbe_khujand_desc: A scenic route through mountain passes and valleys, connecting the capital with the north.
tour_pamir_highway_desc: One of the most spectacular road trips in the world — high-altitude landscapes and ancient villages.
tour_istaravshan_desc: Discover ancient crafts, old bazaars, and traditional Tajik hospitality.
tour_isfara_desc: A relaxing journey through fruit gardens and peaceful mountain scenery.
tour_khorog_desc: Experience the beauty of the Pamirs with local guides and breathtaking views.
tour_penjikent_desc: Walk through the ruins of ancient Sogdian civilization and explore local museums.

about_university_full: Tajik Technical University named after academician M.S. Osimi in Khujand
about_project_desc_1: Туризм Таджикистана is a web portal for promoting cultural tourism in the Republic of Tajikistan. The project was developed as a diploma thesis to create a modern, multilingual, and interactive platform that showcases the rich cultural heritage, natural beauty, and tourist infrastructure of Tajikistan.
about_project_desc_2: The system provides users with the ability to browse cultural objects, plan tourist routes, find hotels and restaurants, read and leave reviews, and switch between three languages (English, Russian, Tajik).
about_goal_1: Create a modern web portal to promote Tajik cultural tourism
about_goal_2: Develop a database of cultural objects, routes, and infrastructure
about_goal_4: Provide interactive maps and filtering capabilities
about_goal_5: Build a responsive, mobile-friendly interface with modern UX
about_system_desc: The application uses a modern client-server architecture with a clear separation between the frontend (React) and backend (Django REST Framework), communicating via a RESTful API.
about_student_info: 4th year, group 400102ra. Faculty of Digital Technologies, Department of Digital Economy.
about_supervisor_info: Scientific advisor and diploma thesis supervisor at the Polytechnic Institute of TTU named after M.S. Osimi.
about_footer_note: Diploma project, Polytechnic Institute of TTU named after M.S. Osimi, Khujand
